While Demand Gen is a staple of our strategy, we lacked clear data to verify its influence on consumer choice. We needed to move beyond reach and quantify how these ads truly sway purchase intent for Louis Vuitton vs. rivals.
approach: To quantify impact, we launched a Brand Lift Study during the Holiday Demand Gen campaign for almost 2 weeks. We deployed a "Consideration" survey asking users to choose which brands they would purchase between Louis Vuitton and rivals like Gucci, Prada and Chanel, isolating the campaign’s effect on festive purchase intent. ooffffeerr..
